captions.detailed: A compact, rectangular floor-standing air purifier rendered in light grey with black edge accents. The front face features a lower rectangular service flap with a horizontal handle, triangular indicator cutouts above it, and a textured filter cassette positioned behind the flap. A black, ribbed control knob is mounted on the right side panel, designed to rotate continuously, while the service flap hinges downward to reveal the filter cassette, which slides outward on internal guides.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a compact floor-standing air purifier. The assembly must include a main rectangular cabinet with black edge outlines, a front service flap that rotates downward on a lower horizontal hinge, a filter cassette behind the flap that slides prismatically outward, and a side-mounted ribbed control knob that rotates continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Box primitive with black edge borders subtracted or styled separately. Create the front service flap as a thin flat box with a handle, and position it using a revolute joint near its lower edge. Model the filter cassette using a box with a slatted or textured pattern, and mount it to a prismatic joint pointing outward. Construct the side control knob by lofting or extruding a circular profile with triangular ridges to create a ribbed cylinder, and attach it to a continuous rotational joint on the right face of the cabinet.
